```{r setup}
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

source("R/fetch_ndbc_history.R")
source("R/fetch_ndbc_observations.R")

lookback_years <- 5
lookback_days <- lookback_years * 365

history_raw <- fetch_ndbc_network_history(lookback_days = lookback_days)

sal_history <- prepare_ndbc_history(history_raw$salinity, "salinity")
temp_history <- prepare_ndbc_history(history_raw$temperature, "temperature")

report_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", tz = ndbc_display_tz)
```

```{r compute-station-stats}
station_stats <- function(df, value_col) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  df |>
    group_by(station_id, station, latitude, longitude) |>
    summarise(
      mean   = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q25    = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q75    = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr    = IQR(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      cv     = sd / mean,
      n      = sum(!is.na(.data[[value_col]])),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sal_stats <- station_stats(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_stats <- station_stats(temp_history, "temperature")
```

```{r merge-and-cluster}
# Merge salinity and temperature stats by station
stats_df <- sal_stats |>
  select(station_id, station, latitude, longitude,
         sal_mean = mean, sal_sd = sd, sal_min = min, sal_q25 = q25,
         sal_median = median, sal_q75 = q75, sal_max = max,
         sal_iqr = iqr, sal_cv = cv, sal_n = n) |>
  left_join(
    temp_stats |>
      select(station_id,
             temp_mean = mean, temp_sd = sd, temp_min = min, temp_q25 = q25,
             temp_median = median, temp_q75 = q75, temp_max = max,
             temp_iqr = iqr, temp_cv = cv, temp_n = n),
    by = "station_id"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(sal_mean), !is.na(temp_mean))

# Feature matrix: central tendency + variability for each variable
feature_cols <- c("sal_mean", "sal_sd", "sal_iqr", "sal_cv",
                  "temp_mean", "temp_sd", "temp_iqr", "temp_cv")

features <- stats_df |>
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) |>
  scale()

rownames(features) <- stats_df$station_id

# Hierarchical clustering (Ward's method on Euclidean distance)
dist_mat <- dist(features, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")

# Fixed k = 4 clusters
n_clusters <- 4

# Silhouette widths for reference (k = 2..6)
sil_widths <- sapply(2:6, function(k) {
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(cutree(hc, k), dist_mat)
  mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
})

clusters <- cutree(hc, k = n_clusters)
stats_df$cluster <- factor(clusters[match(stats_df$station_id, rownames(features))])

# PCA for visualization
pca <- prcomp(features, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_scores$station_id <- rownames(features)
pca_scores <- pca_scores |>
  left_join(stats_df |> select(station_id, station, cluster), by = "station_id")

pct_var <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#e41a1c", "2" = "#377eb8", "3" = "#4daf4a",
  "4" = "#984ea3", "5" = "#ff7f00", "6" = "#a65628"
)
```

## Row

::: {.card title="About this dashboard"}
Stations are grouped by **hierarchical clustering** (Ward's method, *k* = `r n_clusters`) on standardized summary statistics computed from the past **`r lookback_years` years** of QC-filtered salinity and temperature observations.

The feature set includes the **mean, standard deviation, interquartile range, and coefficient of variation** for each variable. Silhouette widths for *k* = 2–6 are shown for reference.

Outliers and sentinel values are removed before computing statistics (salinity `r ndbc_qc_label("salinity")` PSU; temperature `r ndbc_qc_label("temperature")` °C).

**Report:** `r report_time`
:::

```{r cluster-map}
#| title: Stations colored by cluster
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

pal_cluster <- colorFactor(
  palette = cluster_colors,
  domain = levels(stats_df$cluster)
)

leaflet(stats_df) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  setView(
    lng = mean(stats_df$longitude),
    lat = mean(stats_df$latitude),
    zoom = 9
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = 10,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 2,
    color = "#333333",
    fillColor = ~pal_cluster(cluster),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~sprintf("%s (Cluster %s)", station, cluster)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal_cluster,
    values = stats_df$cluster,
    title = "Cluster",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

# Dendrogram & PCA

## Row {height=50%}

```{r dendrogram}
#| title: Hierarchical clustering dendrogram
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

# Extract dendrogram data from hclust object without ggdendro
dendro_segments <- function(hc) {
  n <- length(hc$order)
  merg <- hc$merge
  ht   <- hc$height
  ord  <- hc$order

  x_pos <- numeric(2 * n - 1)
  x_pos[1:n] <- match(1:n, ord)

  segs <- vector("list", n - 1)
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
    left  <- merg[i, 1]
    right <- merg[i, 2]
    x_left  <- if (left < 0)  match(-left, ord)  else x_pos[n + left]
    x_right <- if (right < 0) match(-right, ord) else x_pos[n + right]
    x_mid <- (x_left + x_right) / 2
    x_pos[n + i] <- x_mid
    # Three segments per merge: left-up, across, right-down
    segs[[i]] <- data.frame(
      x    = c(x_left,  x_left, x_right),
      y    = c(0,       ht[i],  ht[i]),
      xend = c(x_left,  x_right, x_right),
      yend = c(ht[i],   ht[i],  0)
    )
  }
  do.call(rbind, segs)
}

segs <- dendro_segments(hc)

label_df <- data.frame(
  x = match(seq_along(hc$labels), hc$order),
  y = 0,
  label = stats_df$station[match(hc$labels, stats_df$station_id)],
  cluster = factor(clusters[hc$labels])
)

ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = segs,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
    color = "#555555",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = cluster),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y - 0.4, label = label, color = cluster),
    angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = hc$height[length(hc$height) - n_clusters + 1],
    linetype = "dashed", color = "#999999"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, name = "Cluster") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.05))) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Ward's hierarchical clustering dendrogram",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line cuts at k = %d. Feature set: salinity and temperature mean, SD, IQR, and CV.", n_clusters),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Height"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{r pca-biplot}
#| title: PCA biplot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$feature <- rownames(loadings)

ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cluster), size = 4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = station),
    size = 2.8, hjust = -0.15, vjust = 0.5, check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 2.5, yend = PC2 * 2.5),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "#333333",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = PC1 * 2.7, y = PC2 * 2.7, label = feature),
    size = 3, color = "#333333", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, name = "Cluster") +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of station statistics",
    subtitle = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%% variance) vs PC2 (%.1f%% variance). Arrows show feature loadings.", pct_var[1], pct_var[2]),
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[1]),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pct_var[2])
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

# Cluster Time Series

## Row {height=55%}

```{r sal-ts-by-cluster}
#| title: Salinity time series by cluster
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

sal_daily_station <- sal_history |>
  inner_join(stats_df |> select(station_id, cluster), by = "station_id") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time, tz = ndbc_display_tz)) |>
  group_by(cluster, station_id, station, date) |>
  summarise(salinity = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

sal_cluster_daily <- sal_daily_station |>
  group_by(cluster, date) |>
  summarise(
    mean_sal = mean(salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = sal_daily_station,
    aes(x = date, y = salinity, group = station_id),
    color = "#aaaaaa", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = sal_cluster_daily,
    aes(x = date, y = mean_sal, color = cluster),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, name = "Cluster") +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Daily mean salinity by cluster",
    subtitle = sprintf("Thin gray lines = individual stations; colored line = cluster mean. Past %d years of QC-filtered data.", lookback_years),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Salinity (PSU)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r silhouettes}
#| title: Silhouette analysis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

sil_df <- data.frame(
  k = 2:6,
  sil_width = sil_widths
)

ggplot(sil_df, aes(x = k, y = sil_width)) +
  geom_line(color = "#555555", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_point(
    data = sil_df |> filter(k == n_clusters),
    color = "#e41a1c", size = 5, shape = 21, stroke = 2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:6) +
  labs(
    title = "Average silhouette width by number of clusters",
    subtitle = sprintf("Selected k = %d (highlighted in red). Higher values indicate better-separated clusters.", n_clusters),
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette width"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r cluster-means-heatmap}
#| title: Cluster mean profiles
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

profile_df <- stats_df |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    `Salinity mean`   = mean(sal_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Salinity SD`     = mean(sal_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Salinity IQR`    = mean(sal_iqr, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Salinity CV`     = mean(sal_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Temperature mean` = mean(temp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Temperature SD`   = mean(temp_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Temperature IQR`  = mean(temp_iqr, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Temperature CV`   = mean(temp_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value")

profile_df |>
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster),
    feature = factor(feature, levels = rev(c(
      "Salinity mean", "Salinity SD", "Salinity IQR", "Salinity CV",
      "Temperature mean", "Temperature SD", "Temperature IQR", "Temperature CV"
    )))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = feature, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", name = "Value") +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster mean feature profiles",
    subtitle = "Average of standardized station statistics within each cluster.",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

stats_df |>
  arrange(cluster, station) |>
  mutate(

    sal_cv  = number(sal_cv, accuracy = 0.01),

  ) |>
  select(
    Cluster = cluster,
    Station = station,
    `Sal mean` = sal_mean,
